name: product-page
title: Product page (stage)
description: Product page layout with a hero, demo, metrics, capabilities, code examples, steps, comparisons, and related products.
usage: A retained stage layout for a product page that leads with a picture of the product. Retained, not current; context.dev's product pages (Parse, Brand search, People enrichment, News, the ChatGPT page) now open with the white ProductHero and continue with the product-landing sections, so start there when matching the live site. Pass the stage's picture as children and the glass texture as `backdrop`. ProductReliability is the Scrape page's reliability section. Code explorers on one page share the chosen language with every other code sample (useCodeLanguage).
avoid: Ringed white cards (this design uses gray panels and hairlines)
More than one blue figure in ProductStats
A third pill in the hero
Syntax themes in the code explorer beyond the site's light highlighting
Using it for a new product page (use ProductHero and product-landing)

reference.source: Retained from website c1cfbca6 (no longer on production main) src/components/sections/products/product-page.tsx; product-page-layout.tsx; product-stage-hero.tsx; product-page-sections.tsx; product-reliability.tsx; and on main product-code-explorer.tsx (+ code-language-store.ts)
reference.scope: Tokenized, framework-independent adaptation. Public measurements cover shared styles; retained variants are not a claim of current public-page parity.
